mapper.sql: id, vehicle_id, trip_id, status, eta_min, dest_name, called_at, last_reminded_at
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM vehicle WHERE id = #{vehicleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM departure_call WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departure_call (vehicle_id, trip_id, status, eta_min, dest_name, called_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{tripId}, 'OPEN', #{etaMin}, #{destName}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE departure_call SET status = #{status}, closed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{callId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE departure_call SET last_reminded_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{callId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS passenger_id, p.nickname, p.push_endpoint, p.push_p256dh, p.push_auth, (SELECT m.quick_code FROM departure_message m WHERE m.call_id = #{callId} AND m.passenger_id = p.id AND m.kind = 'QUICK' ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_quick_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departure_message m WHERE m.call_id = #{callId} AND m.passenger_id = p.id) AS messages FROM passenger p WHERE p.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND p.revoked_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_passenger tp JOIN trip t ON t.id = tp.trip_id WHERE tp.passenger_id = p.id AND t.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND (t.status = 'ACTIVE' OR t.ended_at >= #{prevEndedAfter})) ORDER BY p.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departure_message (call_id, passenger_id, kind, quick_code, body, sent_at) VALUES (#{callId}, #{passengerId}, #{kind}, #{quickCode}, #{body}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.call_id, m.passenger_id, p.nickname, p.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AS revoked, m.kind, m.quick_code, m.body, m.sent_at FROM departure_message m LEFT JOIN passenger p ON p.id = m.passenger_id WHERE m.call_id = #{callId} ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departure_message WHERE call_id = #{callId} AND passenger_id = #{passengerId} AND sent_at >= #{since}
